method: Saved paired PBF captures replayed through the real poller with a fake HTTP provider; disposable PostgreSQL used for persistence tests.

replay.defaultRollback: Reproduced both original speed arrays and map cells exactly.

limitations: Captures were combined for deterministic compatibility checks; they are not simultaneous ground truth or a live accuracy benchmark.
Only I-70-exclusive tiles use finer precision; shared tiles remain default.
I-25 segmentation and zero-speed sensitivity were not resolved by this comparison.
Legacy baselines are unchanged; profile provenance does not convert older measurements.
Raw captures are not included in this record.
scope: Dated local compatibility evidence, not evidence of production activation or improved speed accuracy.
